subject: Decision Making
subcategory: The Science of Risk and Reward
title: Diversification
description: A quick, practical guide to Diversification.

hook.text: Do not put all your eggs in one basket. Diversification is the only free lunch in finance. Harry Markowitz proved it.

buildup.text: Markowitz showed that combining assets that move differently reduces overall risk without reducing expected return.

discovery.text: A portfolio of 30 random stocks eliminates about 95% of individual stock risk. The remaining risk is the market itself.

twist.text: Over-diversification dilutes returns. Warren Buffett calls it protection against ignorance.

climax.text: Diversification manages known risks. It cannot protect against systemic shocks where everything falls together.

punchline.text: Spread bets, cut risk free. Diversification works until everything falls at.

quiz.question: What type of risk does diversification NOT eliminate?
options: Systemic market risk where all assets decline together
